summary.text: Steven Disbrow is the Democratic candidate for Georgia House of Representatives District 1, running against Republican incumbent Mike Cameron in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A computer programmer and co-founder of Improv Chattanooga, he says in a Ballotpedia survey that he has lived in the Chattanooga area his whole life.

paragraphs.text: Disbrow earned a high school diploma from Hixson High School and a bachelor's degree from the University of Tennessee, Chattanooga in 1987, according to Ballotpedia, which lists his profession as computer programmer.

In a Ballotpedia survey, he described himself as a father, computer programmer, actor, producer, comedian and entrepreneur who has lived in the northwest Georgia area around Chattanooga his entire life and moved to Rossville in 2019.
Disbrow advanced from the May 19, 2026 Democratic primary for District 1, in which he was unopposed.

He said in the survey that one of his top goals would be to support nonpartisan redistricting, and that he has proposed a "FAIR Act" requiring companies to evaluate AI systems before replacing employees and providing displaced workers with severance, continued healthcare and retraining opportunities.
